name: To Steal From Thieves
summary: Genavie Callow in Undercity asks you to confront the Dabyrie family at their farmstead in Arathi. Her grievance turns a dispute over stolen belongings into a demand for vengeance.

sections.title: A Bitter Grievance
sections.body: Genavie Callow says the plague took her family and the war left her estate looted and burned. She accuses Kenata and her children of taking the few belongings she still treasured. Now she asks you to bring her the heads of Kenata, Fardel, and Marcel Dabyrie from the Dabyrie Farmstead in Arathi.

faq.answer: Genavie Callow in Undercity asks you to bring her the heads of Kenata, Fardel, and Marcel Dabyrie.

faq.q: Why is Genavie angry at the Dabyries?
faq.answer: Genavie says the plague took her family, the war cost her estate, and the Dabyries stole the belongings she had left.
The Dabyrie Farmstead is in Arathi, northeast of Refuge Point.

faq.q: Who are Kenata, Fardel, and Marcel Dabyrie?
faq.answer: They are the three people Genavie names in her demand: Kenata, Fardel, and Marcel Dabyrie.
